''See also: [[Shatterspine Castle Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Shatterspine Castle is an ancient, fortified structure characterized by dark walls that rise into sharp peaks. Once the residence of a Black dragons{{!}}black dragon emperor from the [[Blackflame Empire]], the castle was located near a massive city that has since been destroyed. The site became part of the Wasteland{{!}}Wastelands following intense combat between a [[Herald]] and a [[Sage]] on the Path of Last Oath{{!}}Path of the Last Oath; the [[Sage]] eventually secured victory by using the [[Grand Oath Array]] to seal the [[Herald]]'s [[Remnant]] and much of his kin. For centuries, powerful figures like [[Sages]] and [[Heralds]] attempted to breach the castle's defenses, but they were unable to overcome the [[Grand Oath Array]] through force or unravel its mechanics. In more recent events, the castle has undergone significant physical changes, including being moved by the [[Rune Queen]] and later being lifted into the air by a [[Ruler technique]]. During these movements, parts of the structure have crumbled or fallen apart, exposing underground chambers and remnants.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Located within a desert, Shatterspine Castle is a structure reminiscent of those found throughout the [[Wasteland]]. Having fallen almost a thousand years ago, the castle was originally moved by the [[Rune Queen]]. During a recent battle, the [[fortress]] began falling apart, leaving its basement in a state of ruin. Within a dark room of crumbled [[stone]] at the bottom of the castle, Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel and [[Orthos]] were located.}}
